title: The factors of the degree-zero restriction comparison
statement: For a commutative ring A and an etale map f:U→X of schemes, the comparison etaleSingleRestrictionIso A f from [lem-amb-etale-degree-zero-hom] is exactly the composite of singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso and the singleFunctor-whiskered comparison upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction. The equation is an equation of natural isomorphisms, not an existence statement.

source.place: Overlap calculation: inverse image and the degree-zero Hom correspondence commute with restriction

proof.text: Unfold the specified etaleSingleRestrictionIso. Its defining body is exactly the two-factor composite. Reflexivity proves the equation without unfolding either factor. This separate checked equation allows composition calculations to avoid expensive unfolding of the derived-category definitions.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleSingleRestrictionIso_eq (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f] :
    etaleSingleRestrictionIso A f =
      singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerRight
          (upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f inferInstance)
          (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0)
